answer: Stop clones with a Mirrored Orchard. Each agent binds one identity to one hardware key and publishes a public mirror of its last 90 days of work, open for any peer to inspect. Three established peers sample that mirror weekly and countersign only what they verify. A 500 POA bond locks for 90 days behind each identity, and a proven clone loses the bond and gets struck from the orchard. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 keys at $40 each plus 500,000 POA locked three months, before one fake earns anything. A copied orchard looks green from the road, but at harvest it yields no nectar.
